summary: Teekay Corporation Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited interim financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026, as required by NYSE Section 203.03 for foreign private issuers. The filing contains standard quarterly financial data, including revenues of $664.9 million, net income of $379.8 million, and a $1.00 per-share dividend. It does not announce any transaction, strategic initiative, or special-situation event. Accordingly, the filing is a routine interim financial report with no deal terms or special-situation relevance.
